name: Ōmihachiman (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Ōmihachiman city emblem in white: an outlined octagonal device enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Ōmihachiman, a city in Shiga Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 25 July 1954.

features.role: Ōmihachiman city emblem — an outlined octagonal device enclosing a stylised character
